Rachel: Berlin? Why Berlin?

Chandler: I've heard it's a really cool city with a lot of history and culture. Plus, it's completely different from New York.

Joey: Hey, I've been there. It's got some great sausages.

Rachel: You know what, I'm in. Let's go to Berlin.

(Scene transitions to Central Perk, New York City)

(The gang is back in Central Perk, sitting on the couch, reminiscing about their Berlin adventure.)

Chandler: I can't believe we actually did it. We went to Berlin.

Rachel: Yeah, it was amazing. I'm so glad we went.

Monica: I'm so glad we had this experience together.

Phoebe: I'm going to miss the sausages.

Joey: Yeah, but we'll always have the memories. And the sausages.

(The scene fades to black as the gang laughs and continues to reminisce about their Berlin adventure.)
